name: com.pancakedevs.apexphysics
description: A PC-first Unity physics framework for grounded physical NPC locomotion, planted procedural footsteps, motor-driven NavMesh movement, momentum-preserving ragdolls, get-up recovery, grabbable objects, barcode-driven crates with Void scene previews, built-in package updates, navigation, lighting workflows, and reusable physics gameplay. VR character support is planned after the desktop character foundation is stable.

samples.description: Starter content for testing Apex physics components.
